text: The CopyFileToOfflineStore migration registers a scope-exit discard after obtaining an optional output stream. Each parsed line uses SyncWriteAll. Only a successful store finish sets the returned token and releases the guard; early returns or a failed finish leave discard armed. This cleanup covers the store stream, not all database state: the header is added before finish, pending attributes and notifications follow, and the current OnCopyCompleted caller explicitly ignores the helper result. A fake message key is still needed when no server UID is known; checked current Message-ID mapping notifies a later pseudo-key change, but this is not a full reconciliation proof. No IMAP, send-filter or store runtime test ran.
title: Keep offline-store cleanup armed until the write commits
